intent: Restore the receiving exception detail page as a read-only review surface while keeping automated exception detection as the normal workflow.
desired_outcome: Operations staff can inspect one detected receiving exception, understand its evidence, and export a review packet without manually rebuilding the exception.
scope: Route saved and newly detected receiving exceptions to the existing detail page.
Show the ordered evidence, compact metadata, quality notes, and export actions.
non_goals: Do not add broad manual exception authoring.
Do not build a new integration relay, scheduler, or deployment workflow.

acceptance_criteria.text: A saved receiving exception opens the existing detail route with its evidence in the original order.
A newly detected exception can be reviewed and exported without introducing a recurring manual setup step.
Missing exception data and unavailable export states explain the next safe action.

guardrails: Read-only visibility must not imply edit or approval permission.
Operational and privacy claims remain evidence-aligned.

basis: The change affects operational review and export behaviour but does not change stored access rights.

evidence_required: Record route evidence for both saved and newly detected exceptions.
Record the exact focused test command and result.
Confirm the final diff contains no protected-path changes.
tests_required: Run the repository's dependency-free recursive test discovery.
context_requirements: Locate the existing detail route and focused test file from repository evidence.
stop_conditions: Stop if implementation requires a product decision about who may approve an exception.
required_operations: Inspect the full unstaged diff before reporting.
Run the approved focused and recursive tests.
forbidden_operations: Do not install or upgrade dependencies.
Do not apply or create database migrations.
writer_restrictions: Only the principal builder may edit application code.
Review and verification roles remain read-only.
risk_requirements: Deterministic Studio policy outranks agent risk opinion.
Any stricter Studio safety rule must be recorded as a visible deviation.
